issues.legal_issue: A delayed challenge to land acquisition proceedings remains barred by laches even when a fresh challenge has been permitted, unless the challengers overcome the delay-based bar.
material_facts: Possession of the acquired land was taken and compensation was paid.
The claimants pursued compensation references and appeals, and the compensation proceedings attained finality.
Years later, the claimants challenged the acquisition proceedings on the ground that the award was invalid.
The challenge was dismissed as barred by laches, and the dismissal was upheld on appeal.
The claimants had been permitted to pursue appropriate proceedings based on their grievance under the later land acquisition law.
issues.conclusion: The Court upheld the dismissal of the acquisition challenge as barred by laches. Permission to bring a fresh challenge did not remove the need to overcome that bar, and the claimants had not done so.
issues.legal_principle: A challenge to acquisition proceedings may be rejected for laches when brought after substantial delay, including where possession has been taken and compensation proceedings have been pursued. Permission to bring a fresh proceeding does not itself overcome laches. In affirming the High Court’s delay finding, the Court found no infirmity in its application of the principles reflected in Aflatoon v. Lt. Governor of Delhi, Swaika Properties Pvt. Ltd. v. State of Rajasthan, Sawaran Lata v. State of Haryana, and Banda Development Authority, Banda v. Moti Lal Agarwal.

rule.if: acquisition_challenge_proceeding and substantial_delay_in_challenging_acquisition and possession_taken and compensation_paid and compensation_claim_pursued_to_finality and fresh_challenge_permitted

predicates.acquisition_challenge_proceeding: The claimant brings a proceeding challenging the validity of a land acquisition.
predicates.substantial_delay_in_challenging_acquisi: The claimant waits a substantial period after the acquisition before challenging it.
predicates.possession_taken: The acquiring authority takes possession of the acquired land.
predicates.compensation_paid: The claimant receives compensation for the acquired land.
predicates.compensation_claim_pursued_to_finality: The claimant pursues proceedings seeking compensation, and those proceedings reach finality.
predicates.fresh_challenge_permitted: A court permits the claimant to bring a fresh proceeding concerning the acquisition or a related grievance.
predicates.acquisition_challenge_barred_by_laches: The acquisition challenge is rejected as barred by laches.

issues.definition: When a claimant brings a substantially delayed acquisition challenge after possession has been taken, compensation has been paid, and compensation proceedings have reached finality, permission to bring a fresh challenge does not prevent the challenge from being barred by laches.
